text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about our next training session— 
...*yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ngh! S-Sorry. Ugh, I gotta focus...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I ran alongside another 
Umamusume... and I lost by 0.1 seconds."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I just can't get it out of my head! Not 
when I do yoga before bed, not when I 
crawl under the covers! Not at aaall!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I tried counting sheep too! But before I 
knew it, the sheep turned into that 
Umamusume... Uuu~...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch! Next time, I'm definitely 
going to win! ...*yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overcome with frustration from her loss, 
Almond Eye seemed unable to rest well...
